review.official:
Savage was originally part of
RIM Billiton
Mining Company's security forces. She was an exemplary agent, known for taking down hard targets and protecting key company executives. She now serves as a
guard
for
Rhodes Island
combat squad.

files.description:
Imaging tests on this Operator show clear outlines of internal organs, with no abnormal dark spots or shadows. No unusual traces of Originium particles present in the circulatory system, no signs of infection, confirming this operator as uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
No Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.15u/L 
Take care when performing missions. 

Savage is in incredibly good health. If only everyone could be as healthy as her...
--Medic Operator Hibiscus

Savage uses special Originium Arts in battle that detonate the ground struck by her hammer fractions of a second after impact. She has taken down difficult targets with these Arts.
After a reverse-engineering study on her hammer, the engineering staff found her hammer was not armed with a blasting device at all, but rather, it acted as an unconventional staff. Savage uses the Originium housed inside the hammer to create the blasts.
Although she doesn't fully understand the principles behind this power, when she is manipulating the hammer, she always unleashes tremendous explosive power. 
Other important information cannot be verified without further research.

Savage earned her codename thanks to the massive destruction she causes both in combat and on mining missions. The codename also matches her physique. 
However, despite her name, Savage is a fairly kind and cheerful Operator. She is known to be friendly, reliable, and fun both on and off the battlefield. 
Take not though, she is quite fierce when on the football field, so try not to yell at her while she's playing.

Savage plays a very important role in combat. She clears obstacles to facilitate direct attacks against the enemy. She is also quite effective at protecting her teammates, and casualties are almost always lower than expected with her on a mission.
Sometimes she likes to get in the kitchen and make vegetable soups, mushroom pies, and other Rim Billitonian cuisine for her fellow Operators.
Many Operators call her dishes comfort food.
She has been known to pitch in and help her teammates when she can, and she is increasingly well-liked.
Please do not post the names of suitors she has rejected on the bulletin board in the lounge. Thank you for your cooperation.

[Classified Log] I have already spoken with Savage, and she understands our current situation. It is an issue between her and the Doctor. 
At least Savage will fight for Amiya, and that is enough for now. 
I hope we have enough gumption to resolve this deadlock. 
--Kal'tsit

Savage made it clear she considers Amiya and Kal'tsit old-fashioned.
Savage also stated her identity shouldn't matter to Rhodes Island. She believes as long as she is helping her friends, what and where her mission takes her is unimportant.
She will probably continue to fight as the only one who truly knows her limits.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Heheh, Dr. {@nickname}, What can I do for you today?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Combat missions take up most of my job, where I just havoc around with my hammer... It feels nice to get to sort files like this every once in a while.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: When I worked for RIM Billiton, I was in charge of a lot of things: mining ores, doing geological surveys with electromagnets, all kinds of stuff. Hmm... sounds like a mouthful, right? To put it simply, I smashed what blocks the way and kept digging down!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Amiya has a lot on her shoulders. If only I could help share her burden a little... And perhaps yours too, Doctor. Don't hesitate to let me know if there's anything you need help with!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Providing cover, trailblazing, area denial... I might not be able to literally shield my teammates like the Defender Operators, but I can still protect everyone in my own way!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Did... did I manage to keep everyone safe?... *Sign of Relief* I'm so rapt... Please, Doctor, from now on, let me stay with you and Amiya!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, want a cabbage veggie salad with mushroom pies? Yep, I made three servings! Yours, mine, and another for Amiya. She loves the pies I make!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The running backs on the football field are unstoppable. They just keep charging forward in spite of everything, all to clear a path for their teammates. And then they just fall down and leave it to everyone else to finish the job. Isn't that sort of like what I do? It's very cool! I hope I don't have to get tackled though.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, as long as I get to stay with you and Amiya, it's enough for me. Memories belong in the past, while the future is waiting for us to color it in. Amiya and I will continue to create more memories with you in the days to come!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, seems you've got some time to spare... Then let's go get groceries for tea tonight!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Savage, from RIM Billiton, reporting for duty! The moment I got the message from you and Amiya, I rushed right over to see what I could do. Huh? You don't remember anything? Strewth!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Ooh, I see. Uh-huh… I totally understand it now!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I feel a lot better taking orders from you, Doctor. I won't let you down!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Don't worry, Doctor. No matter how many enemies there are, as long as you're with me, I'll smash 'em all!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Savage, in position!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Everyone, follow me closely!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Begin the attack!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Target located. Attack!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm ready!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What's next?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Leave it to me!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: This one's mine!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Haaaa!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Mjolnir-3, full power!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Piece of cake!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Incoming!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Hmm, guess no mission's too difficult for us!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: What? It's over already? Easy-peasy!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: ...I'd give my performance a C.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: It's too dangerous here! We have to fall back!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Huh? You're really trusting me with work this detail-oriented?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm? Nnngg?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: All done with work for the day!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! And also to you, Amiya, my little beaut~ Here's to the year you grow tall as a tree. And Doctor, here's to... augh, well, here's to a lighter workload! No more overtime!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Yahoo~ Doctor! Good morning!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! I remember you used to love—oh, I bet you don't remember yourself, do you? Oh well, I'm sure you'll still love this butter and pulled-meat pie! It's the taste of a happy life. Amiya's words.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I'm a little dazed all of a sudden, seeing everyone at Rhodes Island so happy. After all we've been through, just having you and Amiya here, safe and sound, is already more than I could ask for. I'll be with you from here on out, fighting to preserve this happiness.
